description: An ancient abandoned cave waterworks sluice distributor: a tall broken slate stone pillar with a narrow dark vertical channel, worn iris-grey stone fins, a fractured horizontal lintel, small attached lower stepped basin and two bent dark iron braces. Strong asymmetrical silhouette. Tiny 3/4 top-down action RPG asset, native 96x96 pixels, base at x48,y90, subject 65px tall. Restrained architecture, large quiet angular stone faces, few purposeful fractures, upper-left chisel edges, convincing weight and grounded broad foot. No active water, no blue lights, no crystals, no glowing runes, no backdrop, no scene, no plants, transparent background. Crisp one-pixel details only at important joints, no uniform noise, no soft alpha.
